name: mrca-mav
summary: MATLAB code for chance-constrained NMPC collision avoidance of MAVs among moving obstacles and other robots.
why_it_matters: Reference implementation of an uncertainty-aware quadrotor MPC, the strongest baseline for clearance inflated by uncertainty.
hackathon_notes: License GPL-3.0 (gh api), last push 2020-06-30. MATLAB, so read for the formulation and re-implement the collision-probability bound in Python.

name: NanoMap
summary: C++/ROS library that answers obstacle proximity queries from a history of depth frames and noisy relative poses, without building a fused map.
why_it_matters: Shows how to make obstacle distance itself uncertainty-aware in the body frame.
hackathon_notes: gh api shows license NOASSERTION, last push 2018-06-18. ROS 1. Treat as read-only for a product; borrow the idea, not the code.

name: rhem_planner
summary: Uncertainty-aware receding-horizon exploration planner that picks paths minimising expected visual-inertial localization uncertainty.
why_it_matters: Example of VIO uncertainty driving route choice on a real aerial robot.
hackathon_notes: No license field (gh api), last push 2018-05-30, ROS 1. Read-only. URL redirects from unr-arl/rhem_planner.

name: DecompROS
summary: ROS wrapper and visualisation for the DecompUtil convex decomposition.
why_it_matters: Quick way to see safe flight corridors in RViz.
hackathon_notes: License BSD-3-Clause (gh api), last push 2018-09-10, ROS 1. Only needed for visualisation.

name: PX4-CBF
summary: Documentation and setup for a CBF safety filter inside the PX4 position controller that minimally changes the acceleration setpoint using onboard range data. The code lives on the ntnu-arl/PX4-Autopilot fork, branch cbf.
why_it_matters: The product-shaped close-area safety filter: already in PX4, range-only, tested on VOXL2 Mini.
hackathon_notes: License BSD-3-Clause (gh api), last push 2025-10-16. Needs NTNU's PX4, mavlink and mavros forks. Fork branch cbf (HEAD e7ef0c61, 2025-02-12) ships only the closed-form single-constraint filter, with no FoV constraint; the paper's FoV-constrained qpOASES QP is in the earlier commit 338fb51f. README says the FoV variant crashes on PixRacer Pro. PX4 parameter defaults (CBF_EPSILON 0.5, CBF_KAPPA 10, CBF_ALPHA 1, CBF_POLE0 -2, CBF_ENABLED 0) differ from the paper's flight values (Table II: eps 0.7, kappa 70, alpha 2, p0 -2.5); use Table II, which matches composite_cbf. For 48h, re-implement in Python and run both arms (shipped closed form and FoV QP); see docs/research/close-area-nav/05-cbf-baselines-faithful.md.

name: composite_cbf
summary: ROS implementation of the composite CBF safety filter that combines many range points into one barrier.
why_it_matters: Companion-computer version of PX4-CBF; easier to run next to a planner over MAVROS.
hackathon_notes: License BSD-3-Clause (gh api), last push 2026-05-26. ROS-based; read the barrier construction and port the math to Python for the sim.

name: cbf_quadrotor
summary: Python exponential CBF for a simple 3D quadrotor model with cascaded PID, single-obstacle and two-robot examples; lecture slides from the AirLab 2020 summer school.
why_it_matters: Smallest working Python CBF-on-quadrotor to start a 48h safety-filter build.
hackathon_notes: License MIT (gh api), last push 2022-12-24. README pins Python 3.7.2 via pyenv; expect to update dependencies. Use for the barrier math; swap in RotorPy or a double integrator for dynamics.

name: CBF_QP_safety_filter
summary: Python 2D playground for a CBF-QP safety filter that minimally modifies a user command, with a disturbance-observer variant.
why_it_matters: Clear minimal example of the filter pattern, including handling of an unknown disturbance.
hackathon_notes: No license field (gh api), so read-only. Last push 2026-01-09. Good to read in 30 minutes before writing your own.

name: gatekeeper
summary: Supplementary materials for the gatekeeper paper: PDF with appendix, videos and notebook code for backup-trajectory safety verification.
why_it_matters: Planner-agnostic safety layer with a hover backup; a simple story for reviewers.
hackathon_notes: License MIT (gh api), last push 2023-10-20. Notebooks, not a library; re-implement the commit-longest-safe-prefix loop in the sim.

name: safe-control-gym
summary: PyBullet cart-pole and quadrotor environments with CasADi symbolic dynamics and constraint handling, for benchmarking learning-based and safe control.
why_it_matters: Python quadrotor environments with constraints built in, a ready test bed for comparing safety filters.
hackathon_notes: License MIT (gh api), last push 2026-04-29. Includes safety-filter baselines per its description; check Python version pins before day 0. Formerly utiasDSL/safe-control-gym.
